run_fuse_gmock: run fuse_gmock_files.py to fuse Google Mock and Google Test source code into three files
run_fuse_gmock_with_root: run fuse_gmock_files.py with a custom GMOCK_ROOT_DIR and output directory path
fuse_gmock_h: create a fused gmock/gmock.h header file from Google Mock source headers
fuse_gmock_gtest_all_cc: build a combined gmock-gtest-all.cc file that fuses gtest-all.cc and gmock-all.cc
validate_gmock_root_dir: validate that a given directory is a valid Google Mock root directory
